verdict.rationale: Deel documents a broad public REST API (e.g., creating contractor contracts), OAuth2 and token auth, versioning, and webhooks. Its MCP server exposes tools that map to API operations across contracts, people, payroll, time off and cost calculations. This shows substantial programmatic coverage, but nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates that the API matches what the UI can do, against a platform scope of hiring, paying and equipping workers in 150+ countries. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or endpoint coverage map, evidence that payroll runs, onboarding, equipment and compliance workflows are API-accessible, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
